main_text.l: [S]Cripsit haud ita pridem, ferventibus in Anglia contentionibus cum super disciplina & regimine Ecclesiæ, tum imprimis Episcopatu ferendo, an eliminando, an denique aliquâ ratione moderando, sententiam suam de posteriori articulo, sive de Reductione Episcopatus ad formam regiminis Synodici, in antiquâ Ecclesiâ recepti, magnus vir, & ætate, doctrinâ, ac pietate excellens admodum atque venerandus, Jacobus Usserius, Armachanus.

Quod ad prævertendas graves ex illâ dissensione enatas postea turbas, & componendos animos, atque beandas meliori pace Fortunatas Insulas expo-suit suum consilium ann. clɔ Iɔ cxli. atque propriâ manu scriptum subsigna-tum.

page.notes: The woodcut initial S is decorative and is joined to "Cripsit". Some words in the running head are faint show-through and were read with doubt. "clɔ Iɔ cxli" is printed with reversed C and D forms, rendered as MDCXLI in the old style. Line "beandas" as printed.
